name: Store-as-is (Lossless Media Storage)
summary: Stores already-compressed media (JPEGs, MP4s, MP3s) untouched to avoid quality degradation or size expansion.
analogy: Leaving sealed vacuum-packed groceries alone rather than trying to repack them.
what_you_gain: Zero generational quality loss; 100% preservation of original files with lightning-fast archive packing.
what_you_lose: No further size reduction on media files.
best_for: Default lossless archiving of photo collections, music folders, and video recordings.
avoid_for: Uncompressed raw media (BMP, WAV) that can easily be reduced with dedicated lossless codecs.
go_deeper: Lossless re-encoding of already-lossy containers (e.g. JPEG or H.264) cannot reduce size without breaking format syntax or introducing artifacts.
